text: Walking through these glass doors into the R+D space, I am awash with curiosity and anticipation. The environment feels both experimental and purposeful, radiating the energy of innovation. The bright lights and bold, colorful walls are almost invigorating, sharply different from the quietness of just a moment ago in the corridor. I sense a blend of excitement and contemplation, eager to see what ideas are incubating within these walls, yet also aware of how artificial and curated this zone feels—an oasis of thought carved out from the ordinary world.
